name: Daak
what: An AI phone caller that rings Bangladeshi leads for a business and talks with them in natural colloquial Bangla to sell, book demos, confirm orders, remind dues or run surveys, then saves the outcome, transcript, recording and a quality review.
hard_part: Real-time turn-taking on top of Gemini Live: Silero VAD plus the Smart Turn v3.2 end-of-turn model, a barge-in guard, fillers and a watchdog cut the reply delay from about 1.8–2.3 s to a median of about 1.1–1.3 s, with barge-in stopping the agent in about 0.12 s. It learns a business from its website or documents and must pass simulated-customer preflight before going live.
status: Live demo · test mode (no Bangladeshi SIP trunk yet)
demo_note: Pick a business and take a live call from the agent in the browser (asks for a name and WhatsApp number first)
facts: Always says it is a digital assistant and that the call is recorded, a fixed rule of the product
First sound heard about 0.45 s after the customer stops
Five goal templates: sell demo, appointment, order confirmation, payment reminder, survey
Tested over real encrypted SIP calls from Bangladesh to the server
